title: Scope test-only reference-publication durability diagnostics to their originating caller
outcome: Prevent shared federation mutation/binding/activation/recovery failures from being mislabeled as a reference-publication failure in test output, while retaining underlying error details needed by publication diagnostics and leaving production behavior unchanged.
acceptance: Unrelated federation durability failures and recovery ticks cannot be mistaken for a reference provisioning request in the captured diagnostic output; reference-specific origin is scoped or explicitly labeled.
A deterministic test distinguishes reference provisioning diagnostics from an unrelated shared durability failure; existing authority, error mapping, timeout and retry behavior remains unchanged.
The exact-input independent review pair and maintained full gate satisfy repository landing policy.
